hyps.why: With edge 4 removed, node 1 only reaches the output via node 2, diluting the benefit of a conv on edge 0.
Replacing 'none' opens a new computational path to the output, a larger gain than swapping an existing op.
Removing the direct input-output edge when edge 5 is already gone leaves only edge 4, severely degrading or disconnecting the cell.
Swapping skip in for a 3x3 conv loses learnable capacity, whereas replacing weaker ops with skip adds a useful residual.
If edge 0 is none, node 1 is zero and edge 4 carries no signal, so its op barely matters.
With node 1 receiving no input, a conv on edge 2 processes zeros and contributes nothing.
When edge 5 is none, node 2 is a dead end so improving its input edge cannot affect the output.
Without the node-2 path, the direct edge carries more of the cell's capacity, so a conv there matters more.
Removing edge 4 when edge 2 is none fully isolates node 1, wasting edge 0 and shrinking the cell.
Removing edge 1 when edge 2 is none cuts all inputs to node 2, making edge 5 useless.
